english.note: Use this aspect-and-duration pattern to state how long an action or situation has lasted; Cantonese does not normally add a separate word corresponding to for.

examples.english: I have worked at this company for five years.
examples.traditional: 我喺呢間公司做咗五年。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 ng5 nin4
